## Summary

Describe the documentation, Helm values, example, or packaging guidance change.

## Operator impact

Explain what public users need to know and whether existing installations are affected.

## Validation

- [ ] I tested every changed command where practical.
- [ ] I ran `helm lint charts/mqdeck` when changing the Helm chart.
- [ ] I removed credentials, broker payloads, diagnostic results, and production identifiers.
- [ ] All repository-facing text is written in English.
